response.rationale: Both answers accurately express “to marry” / “to enter into marriage.” Indonesian menikah and Malaysian berkahwin are valid standard forms. The relation is a useful variety-based lexical preference, not an absolute exclusivity claim. Kawin/kahwin are common related alternatives, but they do not create a false-friend contrast between these two entries.
